format: meaning/draft-2
id: assets
name: Assets and finance
description: "Value and money expressed as reusable concepts: currencies and amounts of money."
license: CC0-1.0
concepts:
  - id: currency
    kind: value-set
    labels:
      en: Currency
      ru: Валюта
    synonyms:
      en:
        - currency code
      ru:
        - код валюты
    description: 'A unit of money used to express value, with an ISO 4217 code. Values are keyed by the lowercase alphabetic code. Starter subset: three currencies. No alias is a bare word or symbol that several currencies share ("dollar", "$"): the US dollar is "US dollar", "US dollars" or "US$", so another dollar can be added without a collision.'
    values:
      - id: usd
        labels:
          en: US dollar
          ru: Доллар США
        aliases:
          en:
            - USD
            - US$
            - US dollars
            - United States dollar
          ru:
            - доллары США
        codes:
          alpha: USD
          numeric: "840"
      - id: eur
        labels:
          en: Euro
          ru: Евро
        aliases:
          en:
            - EUR
            - euros
            - €
        codes:
          alpha: EUR
          numeric: "978"
      - id: gbp
        labels:
          en: Pound sterling
          ru: Фунт стерлингов
        aliases:
          en:
            - GBP
            - pounds sterling
            - sterling
          ru:
            - фунты стерлингов
        codes:
          alpha: GBP
          numeric: "826"
  - id: money-amount
    kind: property
    units-of: currency
    labels:
      en: Money amount
      ru: Денежная сумма
    synonyms:
      en:
        - amount
        - amount of money
        - sum of money
      ru:
        - сумма денег
    description: "An amount of money. It is only meaningful together with its currency: its unit is one of the values of currency, so a concept that extends it states the currency as that value (unit: USD), and the check resolves the unit to exactly one currency. A dataset that does not store the currency must still say which one applies."
  - id: fx-reference-quote
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Foreign exchange reference quote
    description: An indicative reference observation relating two currencies in an explicit direction, for a stated reference date and under a provider's methodology. It is not a transaction execution rate, tradable bid or ask, live tick, daily average or closing price. The same date and currency pair may be republished; those fields alone do not identify an immutable observation.
  - id: fx-reference-date
    kind: property
    of: fx-reference-quote
    extends: date
    labels:
      en: Foreign exchange reference date
    description: The calendar date to which a reference quote applies, without a time of day or time zone. It does not assert a publication, retrieval, transaction or rate-setting instant, or an observation at midnight.
  - id: fx-base-currency
    kind: property
    of: fx-reference-quote
    values-of: currency
    labels:
      en: Foreign exchange base currency
    description: The currency in the denominator of a directed reference quote. The rate expresses quote-currency units per one unit of this currency. A model may state it as explicit context when the source omits a base-currency field.
  - id: fx-quote-currency
    kind: property
    of: fx-reference-quote
    values-of: currency
    labels:
      en: Foreign exchange quote currency
    description: The currency in the numerator of a directed reference quote. Its code identifies a currency; it does not identify a country, territory, tender validity interval or a transaction currency. Missing quotes do not imply a zero rate or permission to substitute a successor currency.
  - id: indicative-fx-reference-rate
    kind: property
    of: fx-reference-quote
    labels:
      en: Indicative foreign exchange reference rate
    description: The positive ratio of quote-currency units per one base-currency unit for an indicative reference quote. The pair direction, reference date and provider methodology are necessary context. It is not a money amount, reciprocal, cross-rate, execution price, bid or ask, daily average or closing price. Reversing the pair or combining quotes is a separate derivation requiring an explicit arithmetic and rounding policy; rates must not be summed as amounts.

  - id: quantity

    synonyms:
      en:

        - units
    description: How many units of an item were sold on one line.
    unit: items
  - id: revenue
    kind: measure
    units-of: currency
    labels:
      en: Revenue
      ru: Выручка
    synonyms:
      en:
        - sales
        - sales amount
        - turnover
        - takings
        - spend
        - purchases
        - money spent
      ru:
        - продажи
        - объём продаж
        - оборот
        - траты
        - покупки
    description: The money received from sales over a period, before costs. From the buyer's side the same number is spend, so a question about who buys or spends the most asks for revenue grouped by the buyer.
    measure:
      formula: The sum of the invoice totals of the sales in scope.
      aggregation: sum
      inputs:
        - invoice-total

format: meaning/draft-2
id: assets
name: Assets and finance
description: "Value and money expressed as reusable concepts: currencies and amounts of money."
license: CC0-1.0
concepts:
  - id: currency
    kind: value-set
    labels:
      en: Currency
      ru: Валюта
    synonyms:
      en:
        - currency code
      ru:
        - код валюты
    description: 'A unit of money used to express value, with an ISO 4217 code. Values are keyed by the lowercase alphabetic code. Starter subset: three currencies. No alias is a bare word or symbol that several currencies share ("dollar", "$"): the US dollar is "US dollar", "US dollars" or "US$", so another dollar can be added without a collision.'
    values:
      - id: usd
        labels:
          en: US dollar
          ru: Доллар США
        aliases:
          en:
            - USD
            - US$
            - US dollars
            - United States dollar
          ru:
            - доллары США
        codes:
          alpha: USD
          numeric: "840"
      - id: eur
        labels:
          en: Euro
          ru: Евро
        aliases:
          en:
            - EUR
            - euros
            - €
        codes:
          alpha: EUR
          numeric: "978"
      - id: gbp
        labels:
          en: Pound sterling
          ru: Фунт стерлингов
        aliases:
          en:
            - GBP
            - pounds sterling
            - sterling
          ru:
            - фунты стерлингов
        codes:
          alpha: GBP
          numeric: "826"
  - id: money-amount
    kind: property
    units-of: currency
    labels:
      en: Money amount
      ru: Денежная сумма
    synonyms:
      en:
        - amount
        - amount of money
        - sum of money
      ru:
        - сумма денег
    description: "An amount of money. It is only meaningful together with its currency: its unit is one of the values of currency, so a concept that extends it states the currency as that value (unit: USD), and the check resolves the unit to exactly one currency. A dataset that does not store the currency must still say which one applies."
  - id: fx-reference-quote
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Foreign exchange reference quote
    description: An indicative reference observation relating two currencies in an explicit direction, for a stated reference date and under a provider's methodology. It is not a transaction execution rate, tradable bid or ask, live tick, daily average or closing price. The same date and currency pair may be republished; those fields alone do not identify an immutable observation.
  - id: fx-reference-date
    kind: property
    of: fx-reference-quote
    extends: date
    labels:
      en: Foreign exchange reference date
    description: The calendar date to which a reference quote applies, without a time of day or time zone. It does not assert a publication, retrieval, transaction or rate-setting instant, or an observation at midnight.
  - id: fx-base-currency
    kind: property
    of: fx-reference-quote
    values-of: currency
    labels:
      en: Foreign exchange base currency
    description: The currency in the denominator of a directed reference quote. The rate expresses quote-currency units per one unit of this currency. A model may state it as explicit context when the source omits a base-currency field.
  - id: fx-quote-currency
    kind: property
    of: fx-reference-quote
    values-of: currency
    labels:
      en: Foreign exchange quote currency
    description: The currency in the numerator of a directed reference quote. Its code identifies a currency; it does not identify a country, territory, tender validity interval or a transaction currency. Missing quotes do not imply a zero rate or permission to substitute a successor currency.
  - id: indicative-fx-reference-rate
    kind: property
    of: fx-reference-quote
    labels:
      en: Indicative foreign exchange reference rate
    description: The positive ratio of quote-currency units per one base-currency unit for an indicative reference quote. The pair direction, reference date and provider methodology are necessary context. It is not a money amount, reciprocal, cross-rate, execution price, bid or ask, daily average or closing price. Reversing the pair or combining quotes is a separate derivation requiring an explicit arithmetic and rounding policy; rates must not be summed as amounts.

    synonyms:
      en:
        - price each
        - item price
      ru:
        - цена за штуку
    description: The price charged for one unit of an item on an invoice line.
  - id: quantity
    kind: property
    of: invoice-line
    labels:
      en: Quantity
      ru: Количество
    synonyms:
      en:
        - qty
        - number of items
        - units
    description: How many units of an item were sold on one line.
    unit: items
  - id: revenue
    kind: measure
    units-of: currency
    labels:
      en: Revenue
      ru: Выручка
    synonyms:
      en:
        - sales
        - sales amount
        - turnover
        - takings
        - spend
        - purchases
        - money spent
      ru:
        - продажи
        - объём продаж
        - оборот
        - траты
        - покупки
    description: The money received from sales over a period, before costs. From the buyer's side the same number is spend, so a question about who buys or spends the most asks for revenue grouped by the buyer.
    measure:
      formula: The sum of the invoice totals of the sales in scope.
      aggregation: sum
      inputs:
        - invoice-total
